data.fund_type: An open ended hybrid scheme investing predominantly in debt instruments.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate regular income by investing mainly in a portfolio of quality debt securities and money market instruments. It also seeks to generate capital appreciation by investing some percentage in a mix of equity instruments. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Debt/Money Market :75-90%, Equity:10-25%, Units issued by InvIT:0-10%. Please refer the Scheme Information Document for complete details.
data.fund_managers: FM -1-Mr. Pratik Harish Shroff, FM -2-Mr. Karan Doshi
data.exit_load: 12% of the units allotted shall be redeemed or switched out without any exit load, on or before completion of 90 days from the date of allotment of units. 1% on remaining units if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 90 days from the date of allotment of units Nil, if redeemed or switched out after completion of 90 days from the date of allotment of units.
